chat.resize_canvas_and_apply.tip: The canvas becomes the size of the result (Undo works); other layers are cropped or padded with empty space
main.delete_pixels_of_color.tip: Erases every pixel of this color on all layers (they become transparent); Undo works
menu.tune_operation.tip: Any operation with parameter fields and a live Before/After preview: for background removal, cleanup and the rest
tuner.title: Tune an operation
tuner.nothing_changed: Nothing changes: no matching pixels with these parameters. Change the values.
tuner.hint: Change the numbers: the preview on the right updates by itself. Hover a field for details.
canvas.resize_grip.tip: Drag to change the canvas size (the content stays at the top left corner)
chat.what_to_ask: 1. What to ask the chat for
chat.kind_image.tip: The chat sends a processing pipeline for the current layer (you attach a photo in the chat)
chat.kind_sprite.tip: No reference: the chat describes a sprite out of primitives (rectangles, ellipses, lines)
chat.kind_sheet.tip: No reference: directions (S, N, E, W) and animation frames in one JSON, with custom frames
chat.sheet_summary: Sheet {0}×{1}: frame {2}×{3}, rows {4}, frames per row {5}
chat.open_sprite_new_document.tip: Open the sprite as a document of its own size (the current document is replaced)
chat.layout_rule: The prompt requires exactly this layout. Frame names and delays missing from the answer are taken from it; if the answer gives them, the answer's are used.
chat.layout_from_sheet: Layout of the current sheet (required in the answer): {0}
chat.layout_bad: Check the frame size (1..256) and the delay (0..60 s): the layout was not applied.
chat.layout_differs: ⚠ The answer differs from the requested layout: {0}. You can still preview and open it.
chat.fill_current_sheet.tip: Replace the picture of the current sheet; its rows, frame names and delays stay as they are (Undo works)
chat.open_new_sheet.tip: A new document with the layout of the answer (what the answer omits is taken from the requested layout)
chat.sheet_filled: Sheet picture replaced: {0} rows, {1} frames. Rows, frame names and delays were not changed.
chat.sheet_opened: Sheet opened: {0} rows, {1} frames, frame {2}×{3}. Export: the Animation menu.
menu.transform_layer.tip: Without a selection it acts on the whole layer (one undo step)
menu.rotate90_layer.tip: Without a selection the whole layer turns. A non-square layer turns around its center and the edges are cropped (like "Rotate by angle…")
menu.snap_to_palette.tip: Every color of the layer is replaced by the nearest color of the project palette
menu.reduce_colors.tip: Opens the tuner: how many colors to keep, with or without dithering
menu.brightness_contrast.tip: Opens the tuner: brightness, contrast, saturation
auto.palette_empty: The project palette is empty: add colors or pick a set in "Library…"
auto.selection_needs_same_size: Only operations that keep the picture size can be applied inside a selection
menu.rsi_needs_project.tip: Becomes available after "New RSI…" or "Open state…"
layers.nothing_to_merge: Nothing to merge: at least two visible unlocked layers are needed
main.merge_visible.tip: All visible unlocked layers become one; hidden layers stay
menu.pipeline_selection_only.tip: Operations and templates change only the selected area. Without a selection nothing happens
